commit.message:
🔒 Fixed SSRF via oEmbed endpoint

ref https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost/security/advisories/GHSA-f7qg-xj45-w956
ref https://linear.app/ghost/issue/PROD-2607

- replaced native `fetch` with the SSRF hardened `externalRequest` method
- added eslint rule to error on usage of `fetch`
- fixed some type errors for `got` related objects

Credit: Cristian Vargas
